answer: To stem a tide of Sybil clones, an agent registry can bind each identity to a dedicated optical channel. At an audited hub, a photonic lantern maps subscriber fibers to spatial modes while a prism splits wavelength slots, binding challenges to isolated physical paths. Because the hub assigns one key per slot, attackers must lease separate links and transceivers per identity. However, this excludes cloud-only agents and centralizes trust in hub operators.
